text: Everything has a price. Some prices are better left unpaid.
speaker: Enhedu

text: Zik did not answer. He lay down, pulled his cloak over his face, and tried not to dream of water that wrote.
speaker: Narrator

text: They broke camp at first light and continued toward Uruk.
speaker: Narrator

text: Behind them, the last trace of Kurash's footprints disappeared under the morning wind.
speaker: Narrator
